binary_decision.reason: The production return import builds an Ethereum receipt proof, obtains a BFT checkpoint certificate, and submits pftl_uniswap_return_import. The named return script contains no SP1 proving invocation.

minimum_fields.artifact_path: readable absolute path to the return artifact
minimum_fields.artifact_sha256: SHA-256 of artifact_path, exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

runner_required_return_slot_schema.content_addressing_rule: The runner resolves artifact_path and requires sha256(file bytes) == artifact_sha256 before accepting the slot.
runner_required_return_slot_schema.receipt_rule: The return receipt identity must be stable across restart/reload and be included with export/private receipt identities.

production_component_graph.contract: load readiness; POST a custody-free return job; poll durable job to accepted
poll content-addressed return slot; hash artifact; require receipt/finalized state/conservation
build NAVCoin return-burn calldata from amount, recipient, native asset, and nonce
read burn receipt/event; build Ethereum receipt proof; collect BFT checkpoint certificate; submit certified return import; verify accepted summary and recipient balance

exact_next_step_blueprint: Create a loopback Anvil return burn through the existing browser/proxy return-job path using generated in-memory/local rehearsal credentials only.

Run scripts/a666-mainnet-return-import.sh adapted only by existing loopback inputs: phase dir, burn report, validator-2 remote-node CLI endpoint, checkpoint fanout configuration, expected PFTL height, and certified submission artifact dir.

Build the return slot from the script outputs: artifact_path points to the accepted import summary/certificate artifact; artifact_sha256 is its SHA-256; receipt_identity derives from the accepted return-import receipt/burn-event identity; observed_chain_state records finalized fleet tuple; conservation.equal compares before/after route supply and recipient balance according to the accepted import summary.
Run the browser runner only after the slot is accepted and content-addressed.

required: accepted browser/proxy return job and its Anvil ReturnBurned event
loopback checkpoint observer and six-validator BFT fanout/certificate
certified asset-op submitter and expected finalized height
not_required: reuse of the 90-minute export proving pipeline
substitution of the export proof or export artifact slot

missing_capability.description: No producer currently emits the accepted return-artifact slot from the return-import outputs. This is harness/evidence plumbing only; the production return relay and certified import choreography already exist.

estimated_wall_clock.basis: Ethereum receipt proof build plus checkpoint observation, six-validator BFT certificate fanout, and one certified import; no SP1 proving stage.
